text:
Marta: Radium pilot wrap  they agreed to a short case study + optional on-demand demo. Need quote + signed release before any promo.

Diego: They can do Thurs 9:30am PT for a 25-min interview. Prefer to review the hero quote and metric language first.

Zoe (Radium): Thurs 9:30 PT works. We can confirm the headline metric (2.2x inference throughput) and share the runbook under NDA. We'll sign the release once legal confirms.

Rowan (Sales): Heads up  if publish goes live, please add an immediate routing rule so demo requests go to Radium's AE and our SDR. Need SFDC campaign set up.

Marta: Draft hero quote: "With Redwood, Radium realized a 2.2x increase in inference throughput and reduced tail latency." Keep it simple.

Harper (Legal): '2.2x' is fine if they attach the raw results. Also 'reduced tail latency' should be clarified (p95/p99?). We need measurement window and source line in the release.

Zoe (Radium): We measured p95 latency and average throughput over a 30-day test in staging that mirrors production. We'll upload the spreadsheet. Prefer 'p95 latency' in the quote.

Marta: Updated hero: "Radium saw a 2.2x increase in throughput and meaningful p95 latency improvements during a 30-day pilot." Better?

Harper (Legal): 'Meaningful' is vague; I'd prefer 'reduced p95 latency by approximately 40%' or similar with the supporting doc. If they can't share numbers, switch to 'notable p95 latency reductions.' Also I'll attach the release template.

ops-bot: Release templates: https://drive.redwood/release-templates/customer-release-v4.pdf 

Zoe (Radium): We can provide the spreadsheet showing ~38-42% p95 improvement. We'll authorize "approximately 40%" publicly. Signing the release after redline.

Harper (Legal): Uploaded a redline with an embargo option (default 7 days) and the data-source sentence: "Benchmarking conducted over a 30-day pilot; data provided by Radium under NDA." Link: https://legal.redwood/redlines/3627770001

Diego: I'll schedule Thurs 9:30am PT and add a 15-min internal pre-call. @Rowan can you start the SFDC campaign stub so we can route leads post-publish?

Rowan (Sales): On it. Will create SFDC campaign and add webhook to route demo form responses to Radium AE. Will confirm when done.

Marta: Once signed release + spreadsheet are in, I'll spin up a tiny approvals thread for final copy (hero + 3 bullets + CTA). Plan: short blog + LinkedIn post + gated demo landing.

Zoe (Radium): Signing now. Uploading spreadsheet to shared folder: https://files.radium/benchmarks/redwood-30d.xlsx (access granted).

Harper (Legal): Marking redline resolved after upload. Please attach signed PDF to the release folder.

Diego: Invite sent. Internal pre-call at 9:15am PT.

Marta: Drafting copy tomorrow 8:30am PT and will post for 1-round of edits. Target publish: Tues next week if release signed and SFDC campaign live.

Rowan (Sales): SFDC campaign created and linked. Will update with campaign ID in the approvals thread.

Zoe (Radium): All uploaded and signed. Looking forward to the interview. :rocket:
